description: Angular component for a progress bar widget in the Thingsboard platform, handling rendering, styling, and data updates for a customizable progress bar.

classes.name: ProgressBarWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a customizable progress bar widget with dynamic styling and data binding.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, styles, and layout configurations.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up resize observer for auto-scaling after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer on component destruction.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius style based on widget element.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates progress bar value, color, and width based on latest data.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts component size and scale based on container dimensions.
